title: California Academy of Sciences NightLife Plus Admission Ticket
includes: Priority entrance to Osher Rainforest and The Shake House
2 complimentary cocktails and light hors d’oeuvres
Exclusive behind-the-scenes access to the Academy’s research collections with a guided tour
Admission to NightLife at California Academy of Sciences
Private bar in the Gems and Minerals Unearthed exhibit

requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries

blurb:
Explore the nocturnal side of the Academy at NightLife and see what's revealed. Enjoy an amplified evening with access to a private exhibit area with two free drinks and light bites surrounded by dazzling geology specimens. Receive expedited entry to some of the Academy's most popular exhibits, treat yourself with discounts on dining and shopping, and sit back and relax in a planetarium show. 

From 6pm to 10pm, Ages 21+ with valid, physical photo ID.
